entry.title: [TEST] Propagation of chaos for mean-field Langevin dynamics
entry.summary: We prove uniform-in-time propagation of chaos for mean-field Langevin dynamics. The limit is a Wasserstein gradient flow of an entropy-regularized free energy. As an application we obtain convergence rates for training two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime.

entry.title: [TEST] PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for overparameterized networks
entry.summary: We derive non-vacuous PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for overparameterized neural networks. Our generalization bound depends on the sharpness of the solution found by stochastic gradient descent and improves the sample complexity of earlier results.

entry.title: [TEST] A faster GPU kernel for image segmentation
entry.summary: We present a clean and fast GPU implementation of a segmentation network. Benchmarks show a two times speedup on standard datasets.

entry.title: [TEST] Autoformalization of undergraduate real analysis in Lean
entry.summary: We use a large language model to autoformalize theorems from an undergraduate real analysis course into Lean 4 and mathlib, and check every proof with the proof assistant.

entry.title: [TEST] Ricci flow and curvature on surfaces
entry.summary: We study the Ricci flow on closed Riemannian surfaces and give a short proof that the normalized flow converges to a metric of constant curvature.

entry.title: [TEST] Machine learning force fields for catalysis on metal surfaces
entry.summary: We train machine learning interatomic potentials on density functional theory data and use molecular dynamics to study reaction mechanisms in catalysis.

entry.title: [TEST] Identification and estimation in structural models of labor markets
entry.summary: We study identification in structural econometric models of labor markets and propose an estimator with valid causal inference under weak assumptions.
